hard_constraints.hero_footage_brief: niche-relevant to the CUSTOMER's world: African clinicians / hospital / health workers / medical technology in use. NOT abstract circuit boards, NOT generically pretty. Graded to warm cream, seamless loop, <1MB, poster, reduced-motion paused.
hard_constraints._font_note: REVISED 2026-08-13 after studying the LIVE Function Health: FH uses serif display + sans body. Fraunces (headlines) + Mulish (body/labels/stats/UI). Max chose 'match FH serif+sans'. v8's sin was THREE mismatched fonts, not a disciplined pair.
hard_constraints._accent_note: Max chose NAVY+TEAL (logo brand) over FH's rust. Accepted trade-off: cooler than FH's actual warmth (which lives in FH's rust accent). Cream ground kept; navy = ink, teal = functional accent.
hard_constraints._layout_note: FH pattern for 'how it works' = soft rounded numbered CARDS with a small visual each (NOT a pinned scroll stepper - that was over-engineering). FH left-aligns the hero but CENTERS section headings, and uses italic-serif accent words in headings.

palette.rule: monochrome ground + ONE functional accent, never decorative colour on headings

hard_constraints.photos: VARIED subjects + settings (mixed demographics incl. non-African/white clinicians fine; mixed rooms/scenes). No reuse of the same shot. Honest 'representative / coming soon' slots for real client assets.
hard_constraints.layout: one-pager (acceptable while real client content is thin)
